title: Home Security Unrest
description: Assesses levels of civil unrest and covers hardening entry points, denying visibility, and layered visual, sound, and physical deterrents. Explains monitoring developments, the stay-or-go decision, communicating with family, neighbors, and authorities, and the legal limits on defending your home.
shortDescription: Harden entries, deter intruders, and decide whether to stay or go
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
